title: SKRAFT pipeline state
description: {trackingRoot}/{projectSlug}/state.json, written only by src/cli/state.mjs (report.mjs setup writes userPreferences.reporting). x-owner mirrors STATE_SCHEMA in state-schema.mjs: 'invariant' fields are owned by the state machine, 'orchestrator' fields by the orchestrator through state.mjs set or phase events.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case identifier of the pipeline; the name of its tracking directory.

currentPhase.description: The phase being executed, a phase of phaseOrder, or DONE once every phase closed. Advances only through transition or close-phase.

phasesCompleted.description: Closed phases, in closing order. Append-only.

phaseArtifacts.description: Artefacts each phase recorded with record-artifact, relative to the tracking directory. Append-only.

verdicts.description: Reviewer verdict per phase. A review's NEEDS_REWORK or REJECTED records as CHANGES_REQUESTED.

reviewArtifacts.description: Review files per phase under reviews/{date}/, relative to the tracking directory. Append-only; the latest one decides the phase gate.

retryCount.description: Automated reviewer retries per phase, capped at userPreferences.maxRetriesPerPhase.

reworkCount.description: Manual, human-validated rework passes per phase (incr-rework). Uncapped.

findingsResolved.description: Review findings resolved across the rework passes of each phase (incr-rework --findings).

phaseHistory.description: Written by mark-phase-started (inProgress, startedAt, baseSha) and by phase closure (done, completedAt). DELIVER's baseSha bounds the commits its gate requires.

maxRetriesPerPhase.description: Automated retries allowed per phase before the orchestrator escalates. Default 2.

reporting.description: Confirmed reporting preferences, written by report.mjs setup and validated by reporting-preferences.mjs; see skills/qa-reporting/references/report-contract.md.

adrRatification.description: DESIGN human-ratification checkpoint. awaiting_human while Proposed ADRs wait for the human; resolved once none remain. DESIGN advances to DISTILL only when resolved.
